content:
Let \(P(x)=(1-x)^{11}=\sum_{k=0}^{11} a_k x^k\), where \(a_k=\binom{11}{k}(-1)^k\).

We have
\[
P(1)=0
\]
so
\[
S_{\text{even}}+S_{\text{odd}}=0.
\]
Also,
\[
P(-1)=2^{11}=2048
\]
so
\[
S_{\text{even}}-S_{\text{odd}}=2048.
\]
Subtracting gives
\[
2S_{\text{odd}}=-2048,
\]
so
\[
S_{\text{odd}}=-1024.
\]

\[
\boxed{-1024}
\]
